versions.changelog:
Initial release of Gas War Sniper powered by Teneo Protocol:

- Real-time, block-by-block gas price monitoring with multi-chain support.
- Detects sudden spikes in gas prices and identifies gas war culprits.
- Free, easy-to-use command interface for querying gas, blocks, contracts, and more.
- Provides real-time alerts, historical price charts, and trend analysis.
- Supports Base, Peaq, Avalanche, and major EVM-compatible chains.
- Integrated with Teneo Agent SDK for seamless Web3 payments and authentication.
